summary: Makes the whole element, children and all, partly transparent.
details: opacity fades everything: background, border, text and every descendant, and a child cannot be more opaque than its parent. To fade only the background, use a colour with alpha instead.

values.note: Invisible, but still takes up space and can be clicked.

gotcha: Any opacity below 1 also creates a stacking context, so z-index inside the element can no longer mix with the rest of the page.
